workloads.name: branch-swaps
workloads.source: fn main()->i64{let i=0;let a=2;let b=4;let s=0;while(i<10000){let t=a;a=b;b=t;if(i%2==0){s=s+a*3-b;}else{s=s+b*3-a;}i=i+1;}return s;}

workloads.name: small-calls
workloads.source: fn add(a:i64,b:i64)->i64{return a+b;}fn main()->i64{let i=0;let s=0;while(i<3000){s=add(s,i);i=i+1;}return s;}

workloads.name: recursive-fib
workloads.source: fn fib(n:i64)->i64{if(n<2){return n;}return fib(n-1)+fib(n-2);}fn main()->i64{return fib(18);}
